Questions

How do I get a price?

Text a photo of what needs to go to 1 (647) 688-6978, or send photos through the quote form. We'll reply with straightforward pricing.

How much can you take in one trip?

Our truck holds up to 560 cubic feet and 5,000 kg, so most jobs are done in a single trip.

What happens to the things you take?

Items in good condition are donated, materials are recycled where possible, and the rest is disposed of properly.

Where do you work?

Saskatoon and surrounding communities. Not sure if you're in range? Text us your address with the photo.
